extraction_notes: Source is a 4-page excerpt from a 46-page market research report (Agora Insights, commissioned for Voreas Athletics, dated 2026-05-30).

Market context: athleisure category in Greece valued at €210 million annual retail value (2025) with 11% annual growth (2023–2025). Growth driven by consumers shifting budget from casual fashion, not overall clothing spending expansion.

Competitive landscape: International brands dominate the market. Greek brands Kinesis Wear and AeolusFit hold strongest domestic distribution positions (value and mid-market segments respectively). Premium segment for Greek brands remains substantially uncovered.
Buyer decision dynamic: In-store physical product contact is critical for premium purchases (71%); off-gym/lifestyle positioning (62%) indicates category displacement from activewear-only use.

Research methodology: Quantitative survey (n=1,204 respondents), urban centers only, February–March 2026. Figures based on retail panel estimates. Geographic scope limited to urban areas; may not represent full Greek population or smaller/rural markets.
